name: hollaback
description: One script tag that brings abandoned PayPal checkouts back.

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @hollaback/snippet build && concurrently -k -n server,dashboard,store -c magenta,cyan,yellow "pnpm --filter @hollaback/server dev" "pnpm --filter @hollaback/dashboard dev" "pnpm --filter @hollaback/demo-store dev"
scripts.dev:mock: pnpm --filter @hollaback/snippet build && concurrently -k -n server,dashboard,store -c magenta,cyan,yellow "pnpm --filter @hollaback/server dev:mock" "pnpm --filter @hollaback/dashboard dev" "pnpm --filter @hollaback/demo-store dev"
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test
